name: Soft Feather
description: Sell for $400. Kept forty years in a bridge-builder's journal (the Sky Bridge).

name: Ice Carving
description: A carving of your starter, made by the Ice Sculptor of the Frozen Cavern. It does not melt.
family: Key items: tickets, keys and story items

name: Crane's Rope
description: Elspeth Crane's father's rope. Gets you out of a hazard free, once per region.
family: Key items: tickets, keys and story items

name: Crystal Chip
description: Sell for $600. A chip of singing quartz from the Crystal Hollow; it hums when held to the ear.

name: Dynamax Candy
description: Max HP +5% for one Pokémon. Left glowing where a Power Spot eruption was fought down.

name: Fake Charm
description: A counterfeit lucky charm. Next wild battle: the strongest of three Pokémon appears. Then it breaks.

name: Ember Relic (Seed)
description: Ember relic, a seed from the Relic Tree. Held: Fire moves +5%. Grows with you.

name: Ember Relic (Bough)
description: Ember relic grown to a bough. Held: Fire moves +10%.

name: Ember Relic (Crown)
description: Ember relic in full crown. Held: Fire moves +10%; the holder can't be burned.

name: Leaf Relic (Seed)
description: Leaf relic, a seed from the Relic Tree. Held: Grass moves +5%, healing items +5%. Grows with you.

name: Leaf Relic (Bough)
description: Leaf relic grown to a bough. Held: Grass moves +10%, healing items +10%.

name: Leaf Relic (Crown)
description: Leaf relic in full crown. Held: Grass moves +10%, healing items +10%; with the crown worn, the party heals 5% after each battle.

name: Tide Relic (Seed)
description: Tide relic, a seed from the Relic Tree. Held: Water moves +5%. Grows with you.

name: Tide Relic (Bough)
description: Tide relic grown to a bough. Held: Water moves +10%.

name: Tide Relic (Crown)
description: Tide relic in full crown. Held: Water moves +10%; the holder's first move at a foe each battle can't miss.

name: Withered Relic
description: Sell for $50. What is left of a relic seed you gave up at the Relic Shrine.
